name: hecaton
description: Desktop orchestrator for running several web games side by side, each in an isolated browser session.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test

//engines: 22.12, not 20: electron@43.4.0 declares engines.node >= 22.12.0 and vite (pulled in by vitest) declares ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, so 22.0-22.11 satisfies neither. Vitest itself is looser and is not the constraint. All three workflows run 22. The floor said 20 until 2026-08-20, when an audit noticed it contradicted the dependency that defines it. engine-strict is not set, so this warns rather than refuses - the value of stating it is that it is now true.
//allowScripts: npm 11+ blocks dependency install scripts. These two compile native code and are inert without an entry here. Approving the parent does NOT cover the transitive extract-file-icon - it needs its own line, which is easy to miss because the install still succeeds and only fails at runtime. electron is deliberately NOT listed: it ships no install script at all, and its binary is fetched by running `node node_modules/electron/install.js` explicitly - see docs/troubleshooting.md.
